facts.fact: The authority gave reasoned opinions, undated in the decree, on the draft authorising the national police to collect traveller identity and fingerprint data at borders; general opinions, not a decision on a named controller; date given is the decree's.
facts.system: Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel (APDP)

facts.fact: The decree of 11 March 2020 is taken under the code du numérique, law n° 2017-20 of 20 April 2018, which it cites as its legal basis.
facts.system: Code du numérique (loi n° 2017-20, as amended by loi n° 2020-35)

facts.fact: Decree 2020-187 of 11 March 2020 was taken on the interior minister's proposal after reasoned opinions of the Autorité de Protection des Données personnelles (APDP).
